summary: Iteration 6: everything requested passed. The header brand shows 'Learning AI Africa' with the tagline 'A Future Options learning initiative' on desktop (1920) and mobile (390), with no overflow. Real email sending works. Register, forgot-password and resend-verification for delivered@resend.dev each sent an email: the backend log shows 'POST https://integrations.emergentagent.com/api/v1/email/send HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted' three times and no 'Welcome/Password reset/Verification email failed', 'Email send failed' or 'Email paused' lines. Verifying the email through /verify-email?token=... using a token inserted in the db worked. After that, the in-app AI 'Try it' with GPT 6 Luna on lesson-01 streamed a real answer (177 chars after 4s, 767 chars when finished, plain British English, no error). That was one AI call only. Cleanup is done.
